collection.description: The morning begins with spilled porridge, a missing sandal, and a child who refuses to leave the house.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The morning begins with spilled porridge, a missing sandal, and a child who refuses to leave the house. By midday, (name1), the parent, is tired and irritable. They love their child, but love has not made the day easy.

choices.label: Take a Brief Pause While the Child Is Safely Supervised
Turn the Chores into a Game
Ask a Friend to Share the Work
Admit That Today Has Been Difficult

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A few quiet breaths help the parent return with patience.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The interruption is too short to restore their energy, so they ask another caregiver for help.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child eagerly joins in, and the work finally gets done.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The game creates an even bigger mess, and they both burst into laughter.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The friend watches the child while the parent finishes urgent tasks.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The friend is busy, but helps arrange support later in the week.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The child says they had a hard day too, and they sit together for a while.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The parent apologizes for snapping earlier, then calmly explains what still needs to happen.
